kick_channel.source: docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5, citing Posiflex, CR-4000-G2, https://www.posiflex.com/product-detail/cr-4000-g2-series_4100-g2-series/: “Printer driven, powered by printer or Posiflex system CR port, support 12V/24V voltage range”

pin.source: Not stated by any seed source: which pin fires it is not named (docs/hardware-lab.md §4.5 and the documents it cites). It is the drawer's property, recorded in the printer profile once measured (ref/hardware-and-receipts.md §6a).
